class.name: OcgBrepbuilderapiSewing
class.description: ! Provides methods to ! ! - identify possible contiguous boundaries (for control ! afterwards (of continuity: C0, C1, ...)) ! ! - assemble contiguous shapes into one shape. ! Only manifold shapes will be found. Sewing will not ! be done in case of multiple edges. ! ! For sewing, use this function as following: ! - create an empty object ! - default tolerance 1.E-06 ! - with face analysis on ! - with sewing operation on ! - set the cutting option as you need (default True) ! - define a tolerance ! - add shapes to be sewed -> Add ! - compute -> Perform ! - output the resulted shapes ! - output free edges if necessary ! - output multiple edges if necessary ! - output the problems if any

method.name: BRepBuilderAPI_Sewing
method.description: Creates an object with tolerance of connexity option for sewing (if false only control) option for analysis of degenerated shapes option for cutting of free edges. option for non manifold processing

method.name: Add
method.description: Defines the shapes to be sewed or controlled

method.name: Perform
method.description: Computing theProgress - progress indicator of algorithm

method.name: SewedShape
method.description: Gives the sewed shape a null shape if nothing constructed may be a face, a shell, a solid or a compound

method.name: NbFreeEdges
method.description: Gives the number of free edges (edge shared by one face)

method.name: NbMultipleEdges
method.description: Gives the number of multiple edges (edge shared by more than two faces)

method.name: NbContigousEdges
method.description: Gives the number of contiguous edges (edge shared by two faces)

method.name: ContigousEdgeCouple
method.description: Gives the sections (edge) belonging to a contiguous edge

method.name: IsSectionBound
method.description: Indicates if a section is bound (before use SectionToBoundary)

method.name: SectionToBoundary
method.description: Gives the original edge (free boundary) which becomes the the section. Remember that sections constitute common edges. This information is important for control because with original edge we can find the surface to which the section is attached.

method.name: NbDegeneratedShapes
method.description: Gives the number of degenerated shapes

method.name: IsDegenerated
method.description: Indicates if a input shape is degenerated

method.name: IsModified
method.description: Indicates if a input shape has been modified

method.name: IsModifiedSubShape
method.description: Indicates if a input subshape has been modified

method.name: NbDeletedFaces
method.description: Gives the number of deleted faces (faces smallest than tolerance)

method.name: FaceMode
method.description: Returns mode for sewing faces By default - true.

method.name: SetFaceMode
method.description: Sets mode for sewing faces By default - true.

method.name: FloatingEdgesMode
method.description: Returns mode for sewing floating edges By default - false.

method.name: SetFloatingEdgesMode
method.description: Sets mode for sewing floating edges By default - false. Returns mode for cutting floating edges By default - false. Sets mode for cutting floating edges By default - false.

method.name: LocalTolerancesMode
method.description: Returns mode for accounting of local tolerances of edges and vertices during of merging.

method.name: SetLocalTolerancesMode
method.description: Sets mode for accounting of local tolerances of edges and vertices during of merging in this case WorkTolerance = myTolerance + tolEdge1+ tolEdg2;
